title: HubSpot static auth token documented masked placeholder, references and masks
summary: The documented masked placeholder of seven hyphen-separated groups of asterisks, an angle placeholder, an environment reference, a template reference, a masked display and a bare scheme in the Bearer slot, and prose that names the slot.
rationale: HubSpot shows the static auth access token example as a row of asterisks in seven hyphen-separated groups and calls it a placeholder (claim static-auth-placeholder-is-not-a-format-statement). It is a documentation device and not a format statement, so it is a documented placeholder and carries no value. A reference, a placeholder and a masked display stand in for a value kept elsewhere. Contract claims cited: static-auth-access-token/static-auth-placeholder-is-not-a-format-statement.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#243). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no token value. That a documented masked placeholder, reference, masked display or bare scheme is not a value is the project's decision; HubSpot documents the placeholder and says it is one (documentation fact only).
